review_title: Psychological therapies for the treatment of anxiety disorders in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
screening_criteria: We considered all randomised controlled trials (RCTs), cluster‐randomised trials and cross‐over trials of psychological therapies for people (aged over 40 years) with COPD and coexisting anxiety disorders (as confirmed by recognised diagnostic criteria or a validated measurement scale), where this was compared with either no intervention or education only. We included studies in which the psychological therapy was delivered in combination with another intervention (co‐intervention) only if there was a comparison group that received the co‐intervention alone.
gold_label_policy_description: dataset labels 1.0 and 0.5 count as INCLUDE; 0.0 counts as EXCLUDE
